result.stdout:
USAGE:
    ngql [INPUT] [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
    [INPUT]    Path to a snippet file, or '-' for stdin (default if no value    
               provided)                                                        

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help               Prints help information                            
    -v, --version            Prints version information                         
        --execute            After rendering, POST the operation to --endpoint  
                             and print the response                             
        --endpoint <URL>     GraphQL endpoint URL to POST the rendered operation
                             to. Required with --execute                        
    -H, --header <HEADER>    HTTP header in 'Name: value' form. Repeatable      
        --var <KEY_VALUE>    GraphQL variable in 'key=value' form. Values are   
                             JSON-parsed when possible (numbers, bools, arrays, 
                             objects); otherwise sent as a string. Repeatable   
        --allow-mutations    Opt in to executing mutations. Default refuses for 
                             safety; mutations have side effects
